svg.title: Silhouette halls: Shadow puppetry
svg.desc: Silhouette halls (2D): a side-scrolling night hall played as a shadow-puppet show. Fisk, a black cut-out on rods, crouches in the dark below a moonlit cream wall, but his shadow climbs the wall to the ceiling, taller than he is. Round the corner on the right a guard's flashlight cone is about to catch the shadow before it catches him; small marks on the floor line show the footsteps he is listening for.
svg.text: NIGHT 4 / BUNK TO OFFICERS' WING / HE IS SEEN BY HIS SHADOW FIRST
